definitions.gloss: faction; school; sect; group sharing a position
definitions.explanation: A group of people sharing a position, ideology, style, or affiliation. Used both as a standalone noun and very often as a suffix attached to a name, stance, or trait.

examples.japanese: ⟦{反対|はんたい}{派|は}→反対派：30532_hantaiha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}める→占める：11799_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: The opposition faction holds the majority.
He is more of a dog person than a cat person.

examples.japanese: {党内|とうない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{派|は}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Support for the reform proposal spread beyond factional lines within the party.

notes:
Attaches as a suffix to nouns, adjectival stems, or proper names to label someone's stance, preference, or group membership. As a standalone noun it usually refers to a political or organizational faction.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{反対|はんたい}{派|は}→反対派：30532_hantaiha⟧: opposition faction
- ⟦{推進|すいしん}{派|は}→推進派：30541_suishinha⟧: proponents; pro-X camp
- ⟦{保守|ほしゅ}→保守：19090_hoshu⟧{派|は}: conservatives
- ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧{派|は} / ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧{派|は}: dog person / cat person
- ⟦{少数|しょうすう}{派|は}→少数派：12492_shousuuha⟧: minority
- ⟦{多数|たすう}{派|は}→多数派：12203_tasuuha⟧: majority

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {党|とう}: political party — a formal organization, larger than a {派|は}
- ⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧: group — neutral; lacks the sense of shared stance
